domain: SAFe PI Planning Facilitation & ROAM Risk Management
title: Unresolved Un-owned Critical Dependencies 1 Hour Before Final Plan Review
context: During Day 2 of PI Planning for a 150-person Agile Release Train, 3 teams discover an uncommitted dependency on the Enterprise Security ART. Security leads state they have zero capacity in PI-1.
dilemma: How do you facilitate ROAM risk resolution and secure executive alignment before final commitment?

must_include: Scope de-scoping or capacity reallocation options
common_pitfalls: Sweeping the dependency under the rug
Forcing teams to commit to impossible delivery timelines

star_model_answer.situation: 1 hour before final PI plan review, 3 teams faced an uncommitted dependency on an over-capacity Security ART.
star_model_answer.task: As RTE, facilitate risk resolution and maintain ART confidence rating.
star_model_answer.action: I brought the Business Owners, System Architect, and Security Lead into an impromptu management review session. We ROAMed the risk: 'Owned' by the Security VP, and 'Mitigated' by shifting non-essential reporting features out of PI-1 to free up security review bandwidth.
star_model_answer.result: The plan was adjusted safely, dependencies were committed with owner sign-off, and confidence vote scored 4.2 out of 5.

title: ART Predictability Index Drops Below 60% across 3 Consecutive Sprints
context: An ART of 10 teams is suffering from severe scope churn. System Demos are missing key features, and Sprint commitments are consistently missed due to mid-sprint emergency work injected by product managers.
dilemma: How do you restore ART flow predictability and enforce SAFe execution discipline?

star_model_answer.situation: ART predictability fell to 54% due to uncontrolled scope injection.
star_model_answer.task: Analyze root cause and coach PO sync and System Demos to restore delivery predictable flow.
star_model_answer.action: I facilitated an Inspect & Adapt Problem-Solving Workshop using 5-Whys. We identified un-vetted feature injection as the primary cause. I established strict PO Sync guardrails, requiring Business Owner approval for mid-PI feature swaps.
star_model_answer.result: ART Predictability Index recovered to 88% within 2 sprints, and System Demo attendance increased by 50%.
